title: Make room for another person
description: Jesus Christ listens attentively to an older man, showing how compassionate presence can honor another person. Read how the Savior made time for people, then consider who might welcome your attention.
alt: Jesus Christ listening attentively to an elderly man in a courtyard

title: Learn from Christ, then practice His teaching
description: Jesus Christ teaches attentive disciples. Read His commandment to love one another, then consider how that teaching can shape the way you speak with someone whose beliefs differ from yours.

title: Let a conversation lead to care
description: Two women prepare a meal together, turning conversation into a practical act of care while leaving room for different beliefs.
alt: Two women preparing a vegetable meal and covering a dish in a home kitchen

title: Read the invitation to come and know
description: Jesus Christ extends His invitation to people gathered before Him. Read the account for His words and notice how each person is invited to come and know.

title: Give a passage your attention
description: A woman pauses beside a quiet lake with an open book in her lap. Read a short passage slowly, consider its setting and record a question before moving on.
alt: A woman with an open book on her lap pausing to look across a quiet lake

title: Compare the accounts with care
description: Two open books invite side-by-side study. Read each account on its own terms before identifying their shared witness of Jesus Christ.

title: Listen to what another reader notices
description: An older woman and a younger man compare open books on a park bench. Let each person name a passage and explain what they noticed before comparing conclusions.
alt: An older woman and an adult man discussing their open scripture books on a park bench

title: Prepare through learning
description: The scene shows preparation. Bring a specific question to the dedicatory prayer and read its language about learning, faith and order in context.
alt: Hands holding an open scripture book beside a closed notebook and folded jacket

title: Connect worship with daily commitments
description: A father and adult daughter talk while sharing the work of washing and drying dishes, connecting promises to God with patient care in daily life.
alt: A father and adult daughter talking while washing and drying dishes

title: Keep the record and your interpretation distinct
description: A writing desk, open record and inkwell invite careful attention to how historical accounts were created and preserved. As you compare them, note who wrote each one, when it was recorded and what question it can help answer.

title: Make room for prayer
description: Jesus withdraws into a quiet wilderness to pray. His solitude and stillness invite a pause before returning to Luke’s account.

title: Study, ask and keep a careful record
description: A notebook can help separate your question, what a source says and a possible next step. Read the instruction to study a matter within its original setting.
alt: A man keeping a notebook beside an open book during a quiet pause

title: Let care extend beyond your household
description: The scene shows care beyond the household. Consider a practical act of service that the person receiving it would welcome.
alt: A parent and teenager helping an older neighbor clear a path

title: Make space for each person’s voice
description: A short shared reading can leave room for different questions, ages and experiences. Consider one teaching you could discuss with a household member, relative or trusted friend.

title: Read the resurrection account
description: Morning light enters an open garden tomb, drawing attention to the hope and astonishment of the Resurrection account. Read what the witnesses encounter and how their understanding develops.

title: Hold hope and remembrance together
description: The scene shows remembrance. Conversation about someone who has died can leave room for both sorrow and hope.
alt: A grandmother sharing a keepsake and a memory with her grandson

title: Bring the whole storm account into view
description: The scene accompanies Mark’s account of Jesus and the disciples on the sea. Notice their question as well as Christ’s response. A miracle in the account should not become a deadline for relief in another person’s life.

title: Take the next step with support
description: The scene shows companionship while taking a careful next step. Consider what support you could seek or offer as a difficulty continues.
alt: A woman using a walking stick beside a companion on a woodland path

title: Listen without setting a timetable
description: Presence can begin with letting someone speak about the person they miss. The scene accompanies the invitation to mourn with those who mourn. Ask what would help, and respect the answer.

title: Leave room for a steady next step
description: The scene shows making room for a manageable reading. Quiet spiritual practice can accompany practical support during change.
alt: A woman reading quietly on a window seat during a period of change

title: Consider a covenant in practice
description: An ordinary act of help can make a discussion about covenant community concrete. Read the baptismal invitation to bear burdens and consider what thoughtful participation could look like in your own setting.
